headline: Canada Outlines $6.5 Billion Strategy to Support Forestry Sector
summary: The Canadian government announced a $6.5 billion plan to restructure its forestry sector, reducing reliance on traditional lumber, pulp, and paper by expanding into higher-value products.
why: Canada's forestry sector is a major traditional pillar of the national economy and a significant contributor to regional manufacturing employment.

impacts.name: Canada
impacts.why: The government outlined a $6.5 billion plan to reinvent the struggling forestry industry.
